wiki.title: Jim Jordan
wiki.extract: James Daniel Jordan (born February 17, 1964) is an American politician who has served in the U.S. House of Representatives as the representative for Ohio's 4th congressional district since 2007. Currently in his 10th term in the House, Jordan is a member of the Republican Party. He was chosen on November 10, 2026, to serve as the Republican House Minority Leader in the 120th Congress which will convene in January 2027.
